validation.method: Scan (no text layer): every table page read by eye at 0.62x of 200 dpi, two pages per image (13 images), plus zoomed REF/REQ'D strips for printed page 7 and spot zooms (p9 gasket kit, p13/p19 footnotes, p51 ref 9). Tesseract only as a draft.
validation.refContinuity: All sections continuous except carburetor_110 (ref 27 not printed; index agrees) and decals_french (only refs 8 and 9, the French versions of the English 8 and 9). 13 rows printed without a ref number (gasket sets/kits, carburetor assembly, air cleaner cups, starter motors, headlight assembly, hex plug), kept and flagged.
validation.quantities: All rows have a printed qty except two (engine_block_116 C27335 gasket kit and electrical_system ref 9 C14537), stored qty '' / qtyNum null and flagged. 11 rows are UAR. Printed page 7 REQ'D sits slightly low; checked on a REF/REQ'D strip, counts equal.
validation.numericalIndex: 792 index entries (part, page, ref; printed pp56-60) compared against the transcription in sort order, both directions, by eye beside an aligned rendering of the expected index (tesseract only used to align rows): all 792 match, none missing on either side. NSS rows are not indexed. The index prints 163- 4 (table prints '163 4').
validation.partNoForms: Briggs BR numbers stored bare (390640), Case letter prefixes closed up (C25709, A27795, D59705, F53650, G46176, H296277, L32763, R15380, T25683), hardware codes 'NNN-NNNN' (221-843), bare 35012 kept. Printed form kept in partNoAsPrinted (including '*' / '**' markers). H-prefix numbers stored as printed, closed up (H296277), not H0: user decision 2026-11-09 (the store carries no H part numbers).
